text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our first concert is finally upon us. Smart Falcon raises the stakes for herself, saying she needs to make it a success in order to attract more supporters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I remind her that concerts are meant to be fun for everyone involved, after which she takes the stage with a smile on her face and a jump in her step.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Out in the audience, I spot Agnes Tachyon and Silence Suzuka, as well as Mihono Bourbon, who dropped by the day before.
